body:
Tier: architectural — changes what three published packages accept and report.
Time ceiling: 6h

Source: issues #312 and #313 (B4). #312 landed in #1218 (JavaScript plants only); rebased on main @ 5343b84b.

PROBLEM.
1. #312 (fixed in #1218). review-calibration discards an unparseable plant, but checks only .mjs/.cjs/.js with `node --check`; every TypeScript-family plant passes through with syntax `unknown`, so an unparseable TS plant still enters the recall denominator.
2. #313. packages/hollow-test/lib/targets.mjs admits only .js/.mjs/.cjs, so `--target x.tsx` and a TS-only diff exit 1. Its syntax gate (`checkSyntax`, lib/runner.mjs) is `node --check`, which cannot parse TypeScript or JSX.
3. Measured: 68.8% of the mutants of upstream's 54 non-test TS/TSX files and 41.4% of a sample of mm-js's do not parse (mostly invert-comparison on generics/JSX). hollow-test takes the first `quota` mutants per file and an invalid one still uses the slot, so with item 1 to 4 alone a TS diff would often exit 1 (`every mutant generated for X was syntactically invalid`). The spec has the numbers.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. @adlc/core gets packages/core/lib/syntax.mjs, exported from the root index and declared in index.d.ts:
   - `syntaxLanguage(file)` returns 'javascript' for .js/.mjs/.cjs, 'typescript' for .ts/.mts/.cts/.tsx/.jsx, else null.
   - `resolveTypeScript(filePath)` returns `{ path, version }` of the first `typescript`, walking up from the file's directory, whose module has `createSourceFile` and `createProgram` (TypeScript 7 is native and is skipped), or null. `typescript` is NOT a dependency of any @adlc package (CONVENTIONS rule 1); it comes from the repository under test.
   - `checkSyntax(filePath, cwd, execPath = process.execPath)` returns 'valid' | 'invalid' | 'unknown'. JavaScript: `node --check` exactly as today. TypeScript family: a child `node` process runs packages/core/lib/syntax-check-typescript.mjs, which resolves `typescript` from the file, parses it with the public API (createSourceFile, then createProgram over an in-memory host, then getSyntacticDiagnostics) and exits 0 when there is no diagnostic and 65 when there is one. Any other outcome (typescript not resolvable, thrown error, crash, signal, timeout, spawn failure, other exit code) is 'unknown', as is an extension with no language.
   - `syntaxCheckProblem(filePath)` returns null when checkSyntax can decide the file, else a one-line message that names the file and says to install `typescript` (for example `npm i -D typescript`).
2. hollow-test imports checkSyntax from @adlc/core; packages/hollow-test/lib/runner.mjs keeps exporting `checkSyntax` (re-export) for existing callers.
3. hollow-test source set (`isSupportedSourceExtension`, `isMutableSource`): adds .ts/.mts/.cts/.tsx/.jsx and excludes declaration files (.d.ts/.d.mts/.d.cts). Test-path and test-name exclusions, --source-glob and --test-glob are unchanged. .py, .css and every other extension stay refused.
4. Before any file is mutated, hollow-test exits 1 when syntaxCheckProblem reports a problem for a target or a target's unmutated content is not 'valid', naming the file (and the typescript version).
5. Invalid candidates do not use budget: hollow-test runs a file's candidates (changed lines; whole file for --target/--rails) in the current order; an `invalid` one does not count toward the file's quota; the file stops at `quota` valid candidates or after `quota * 8` candidates. Exit codes and the existing fail-closed checks are unchanged.
6. review-calibration: #1218's checkPlantSyntax keeps its journal, discard kinds (`unparseable`, `spawn-failed`), `plantsDiscarded` report and `unknown` pass-through; its extension set becomes core syntaxLanguage and its default checker core checkSyntax, so a TS-family plant that does not parse is discarded as `unparseable`. No exit-code or report-shape change.
7. scripts/mutation-gate.mjs keeps importing the predicate; its tests follow the new contract.
8. Docs: the hollow-test, review-calibration and core READMEs and their apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/*.mdx pages describe items 1 to 6.

TYPESCRIPT-ONLY DIFF POLICY (#313's open question). A TS/TSX/JSX diff is now mutated like JavaScript. A diff that still has no mutable source (docs, JSON, config) keeps today's behaviour: hollow-test exits 1 `nothing to mutate`, and scripts/mutation-gate.mjs reports the skip. A TS diff where `typescript` cannot be resolved is exit 1 with the install message, not a skip.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 core: checkSyntax valid/invalid for JS and each TS-family extension (`Promise>=unknown>`, `>=Button>`, stranded `return null;`); 'unknown' without typescript, on a worker crash, for an unknown extension; syntaxLanguage, syntaxCheckProblem. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/syntax.test.mjs`
- AC2 review-calibration discards an unparseable .ts/.tsx plant as `unparseable` and counts it in plantsDiscarded; a parseable TS plant records syntax 'valid'; no typescript: syntax 'unknown', passed through; JS and .py unchanged. verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/invalid-plants.test.mjs`
- AC3 hollow-test: TS family admitted, declaration and test files excluded, `--target x.tsx` accepted, .py refused; no typescript: exit 1 with the install message, file unchanged. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/typescript.test.mjs`
- AC4 Quota one, real git repo: a TS diff whose only candidate is `Promise<unknown>` exits 1, never 0; same for JSX `<Button>`; a killed valid TS mutant exits 0; a surviving one exits 2. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/typescript.test.mjs`
- AC5 Refill: --max 1, first candidate invalid, second valid and killed: exit 0, one invalid and one killed reported; more than `quota * 8` invalid candidates: stops at `quota * 8`. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/invalid-refill.test.mjs`
- AC6 Wrapper: TS family mutable, declaration files and .py not, wrapper and hollow-test agree, a TS-only diff is fast or slow, not nothing. verify: `node --test scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs`
- AC7 Existing suites green. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/hollow-test/test/*.test.mjs packages/review-calibration/test/*.test.mjs scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs`
- AC8 Docs updated. verify: `grep -n 'typescript' packages/hollow-test/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/hollow-test.mdx && grep -n -i 'typescript' packages/review-calibration/README.md`
- AC9 Mutation gate green on this diff. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs <merge-base> --max 20` exits 0

ALSO: the measurement goes in the PR body and one #313 comment.

OUT OF SCOPE: syntax-aware operators (#313 path B; core/lib/mutate.mjs unchanged), Python (#292), type checking (a mutant that only breaks types is valid), JSX in plain .js (still `node --check`), the wrapper's apps/docs test mapping.
title: Mutate TypeScript/JSX in hollow-test and syntax-check TypeScript plants in review-calibration
